title: Refactor UI Logic
problem_statement: The UI logic in Form5 is tightly coupled with business logic, making it difficult to maintain.
risk_if_unaddressed: Increased maintenance cost and difficulty in implementing new features.
suggested_approach: Separate UI logic from business logic using a Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern.
success_criteria: UI logic is isolated from business logic.
Code is easier to maintain and extend.
